introduction_markdown:
**General Certificate of Education Board - General Certificate of Education Examination. Pure Mathematics With Statistics, Paper 3 (0770/3), ADVANCED LEVEL, June 2021. Time allowed: THREE HOURS.**

Full marks may be obtained for answers to ALL questions. Mathematical formulae and tables produced by the GCE Board are allowed. In calculations, you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving the answer at each stage. Electronic calculators may be used. Start each question on a fresh page. The scan contains 8 questions (13 marks each), all compulsory.
enonce_intro_markdown:
The table below shows the time, in minutes, spent by a set of 80 customers at the customers' service of a certain Credit Union.

| Time | 1 - 5 | 6 - 10 | 11 - 15 | 16 - 20 | 21 - 25 | 26 - 30 | 31 - 35 | 36 - 40 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| No. of customers | 3 | 7 | 12 | 16 | 20 | 10 | 8 | 4 |

Calculate, to three decimal places,
incertitudes: Question 1 (c)-(d) : l'ecart-type 8.312 du second echantillon est lu comme un ecart-type de population (diviseur $n$), comme pour le premier echantillon ; l'enonce ne le precise pas. Si c'etait un ecart-type d'echantillon (diviseur $n-1$), la variance de (d) serait 72.557 au lieu de 73.248.
Question 1 : les classes imprimees 1-5, 6-10... sont traitees par leurs milieux 3, 8, 13... (identiques avec les limites 0.5-5.5, 5.5-10.5...).

questions.enonce_markdown: (a) the mean time spent by the customers at the customer service.
(b) the standard deviation of the time spent by the customers at the customer service.
questions.corrige_markdown:
The standard deviation is $\sigma = \sqrt{\dfrac{\sum fx^2}{\sum f} - \bar{x}^2}$.

$$\sigma^2 = \frac{40595}{80} - (20.8125)^2 = 507.4375 - 433.1602 = 74.2773\ldots$$

$$\sigma = \sqrt{74.2773\ldots} = 8.6184\ldots$$

**Standard deviation $= 8.618$ minutes (3 d.p.).**

questions.enonce_markdown:
It was observed that the mean and standard deviation of the time spent by a second set of 20 customers at the customer service of that credit union were 21.037 minutes and 8.312 minutes respectively.

Calculate, to three decimal places,

(c) the mean time spent by the combined set of 100 customers at the customer service.
questions.corrige_markdown:
For the second set, $n_2 = 20$ and $\bar{x}_2 = 21.037$, so $\sum x = 20 \times 21.037 = 420.74$. The first set has $\sum x = 1665$ with $n_1 = 80$.

$$\bar{x}_{\text{combined}} = \frac{1665 + 420.74}{80 + 20} = \frac{2085.74}{100} = 20.8574$$

**Combined mean $= 20.857$ minutes (3 d.p.).**

questions.enonce_markdown: (d) the variance of the time spent by the 100 customers at the customer service.
questions.corrige_markdown:
For a set, $\sum x^2 = n(\sigma^2 + \bar{x}^2)$ (the standard deviation of the second set is taken with divisor $n$, as for the first set).

Second set: $\sum x^2 = 20\left(8.312^2 + 21.037^2\right) = 20(69.0893 + 442.5554) = 10232.894$.

First set: $\sum x^2 = 40595$. Hence for the 100 customers, $\sum x^2 = 40595 + 10232.894 = 50827.894$.

$$\sigma^2 = \frac{50827.894}{100} - (20.8574)^2 = 508.27894 - 435.03113 = 73.2478\ldots$$

**Variance $= 73.248$ (3 d.p.).** (The standard deviation is $\sqrt{73.248} = 8.558$ minutes.)
